name: Solder
author: Erin Carter
description: Four molten beads ride a gently bowed weld seam, summed and smooth-min iso-surfaced so neighbours bulge, neck, and wick into longer liquid slugs. Merges propagate left-to-right down the line like solder drawn by heat, the slug reluctantly re-pinches back into four beads, and the peristaltic round repeats phase-continuously. Bead hue blends from colour 0 at the left to colour 1 at the right with a cool colour-2 sheen on each bead's upper edge.

params.label: Bead size
params.effect: Radius of the molten beads in CSS pixels, setting how fat the liquid sits on the seam.

params.label: Travel speed
params.effect: How fast merge events wick along the seam and how quickly the beads re-pinch.

params.label: Seam sag
params.effect: How deeply the seam line bows downward; at zero the weld runs perfectly straight.

params.label: Sheen
params.effect: Strength of the cool interior sheen on each bead's upper edge; at zero the beads read as pure dark mirror.
